original_value: While in recent years machine learning (ML) based approaches have been the popular approach in developing endto-end question answering systems, such systems often struggle when additional knowledge is needed to correctly answer the questions. Proposed alternatives involve translating the question and the natural language text to a logical representation and then use logical reasoning. However, this alternative falters when the size of the text gets bigger. To address this we propose an approach that does logical reasoning over premises written in natural language text. The proposed method uses recent features of Answer Set Programming (ASP) to call external NLP modules (which may be based on ML) which perform simple textual entailment. To test our approach we develop a corpus based on the life cycle questions and showed that Our system achieves up to 18% performance gain when compared to standard MCQ solvers.

result.paraphrase: Although ML-based approaches have been the popular choice for building end-to-end question answering systems in recent years, such systems often have difficulty when extra knowledge is required to answer questions correctly. Alternative methods translate the question and natural-language text into a logical representation and then apply logical reasoning. However, this approach breaks down as the text grows larger. To address this, we propose a method that performs logical reasoning over premises expressed in natural language. The proposed approach uses recent Answer Set Programming (ASP) features to invoke external NLP modules, which may be ML-based, to carry out simple textual entailment. To evaluate the approach, we developed a corpus based on life cycle questions and showed that our system achieves up to an 18% performance improvement over standard MCQ solvers.
